INSTRUCTIONS: Shared tracking parameters — applies to ALL trackers.
These describe the physical environment and target motion assumptions.
NOTE: volume and beta are NOT here — they are per-tracker because
GNN/TOMHT and JPDA use them with opposite effects.
Tune volume/beta in each tracker's own JSON file.

PARAM_DOCS.max_num_tracks: Maximum simultaneous tracks the tracker can maintain.
PARAM_DOCS.detection_probability.ideal: Pd in clear weather. 0.9 typical for PSR.
PARAM_DOCS.filter.init_speed_kmh: Expected target speed for Kalman filter initialization.
PARAM_DOCS.filter.scale_accel_vert: Process noise acceleration vertical (m/s^2). 20 default. Increase for climbing/descending targets.
